text: I need to ask a few questions to narrow this down. Have you noticed any blood in your urine, and has the fever persisted despite completing your antibiotic course for sinusitis?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis and Urine Culture. Have you noticed any chills, nausea, or pain when urinating?

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN) secondary to antibiotic use. The negative urine culture combined with leukocyturia and the presence of eosinophilic granular cells (eosinophils) on cytospin strongly supports an allergic interstitial nephritis rather than a typical bacterial pyelonephritis. Did you develop a rash or joint pain alongside these symptoms?
